tracking.title: Upcoming
tracking.subtitle: What you're watching, have pre-ordered or bought – until it's in a library.

groups.released: Out now — ready to take over

tracking.emptyText: Games that aren't out yet, that you pre-ordered or already bought are listed here like a release calendar until you move them into a library.
tracking.emptyHint: Use “Add game” at the top right or “Watch” on any game page.

delete.title: Remove from Upcoming?
delete.text: “{title}” is removed from Upcoming. The game stays in the catalog.

statusHelp.watching: You're keeping an eye on it, nothing bought yet.
statusHelp.preordered: Ordered – it's not out yet or on its way.
statusHelp.bought: Bought, but it hasn't arrived yet.

edit.description: An entry on Upcoming – not in any library until you take it over.
edit.readOnly: This entry belongs to {user}. You can only look at it.
edit.statusText: How far along are you with this game?
edit.purchaseText: Where and when you ordered it. Copied into the copy when you take it over.
edit.libraryText: Only if you want: members of this library can see the entry (read-only), and it's preselected when you take it over.
edit.releaseText: Applies to this release in the catalog, so for everyone who has or watches it.
edit.owned: “{title}” is already in {library}. You no longer need this entry.

takeOverPage.description: The game is here: it becomes a copy and leaves Upcoming.
takeOverPage.targetText: Which library the copy goes into.
takeOverPage.copyText: Details of the new copy. You can change everything later.
takeOverPage.carriedText: These details move from the entry into the copy.
takeOverPage.noLibraries: You can't add games to any library.
takeOverPage.notMine: Only the person who tracked the game can take it over.
